paraphrase: At w at least one holds: some individual exists at w and at every accessible world and has no existing supporter at any world; or the selected relation is not well-founded on actual concreta; or some actual root is contingent, with an accessible world lacking it; or the present-support premise fails; or the concrete-supporters premise fails.
